note: field_widget_add_more adds an 'Add another item' button (and per-row Remove buttons) to field widgets on fields whose cardinality is a fixed integer > 1 (not 1, not unlimited). It has no field/widget of its own, no configure route, no permissions, no Drush. Its entire persistent state is a per-component third-party setting field_widget_add_more.add_more (boolean) on the entity_form_display config entity (core.entity_form_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode> -> content.<field>.third_party_settings.field_widget_add_more.add_more). The 'Show add more button' checkbox only appears for fixed cardinality > 1 fields. Medium cases read back which field has the setting; hard cases turn the setting on/off on a capped Article field, verified against the live entity_form_display.

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal field_widget_add_more module do, and how is it different from core's normal behavior for multi-value fields?
evals.expected_output: It adds an 'Add another item' button (and per-row Remove buttons) to field widgets on fields with a fixed cardinality greater than 1. Core renders all allowed rows at once for capped fields and only shows an 'Add more' button on unlimited fields; this module restores the incremental add/remove UX for capped fields without changing storage.

evals.prompt: There is no settings page for field_widget_add_more. How do I turn it on for a field, and where is that choice stored?
evals.expected_output: You enable it per field on Manage form display by ticking 'Show add more button' on the field's widget. It is stored as a third-party setting on the form-display component: core.entity_form_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode> -> content.<field>.third_party_settings.field_widget_add_more.add_more: true (schema field.widget.third_party.field_widget_add_more).

evals.prompt: On which fields does the field_widget_add_more 'Show add more button' checkbox appear? Does it show for single-value or unlimited-cardinality fields?
evals.expected_output: The checkbox appears only for fields whose storage cardinality is a fixed integer greater than 1. The third-party settings form returns nothing (no checkbox) for cardinality 1 or for unlimited (-1) fields, since unlimited fields already get core's own Add-more button.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a capped multi-value field with the field_widget_add_more 'Show add more button' option enabled on its widget. Inspect the live default form display and give the machine name of that field.
evals.expected_output: The field is field_fwam_known (a cardinality-3 field): in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default its component has third_party_settings.field_widget_add_more.add_more: true.

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this site has two capped fields, field_fwam_on and field_fwam_no. Exactly one has the field_widget_add_more 'Add another item' button enabled. Inspect the live form-display configuration and state which field has it enabled.
evals.expected_output: field_fwam_on has it enabled: its component in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default has third_party_settings.field_widget_add_more.add_more: true, while field_fwam_no has no such setting.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a capped multi-value field field_fwam_task (cardinality 3). Use the field_widget_add_more module to add the 'Add another item' button to that field's widget, and apply the change to the live default form display.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default set the field_fwam_task component's third_party_settings.field_widget_add_more.add_more to TRUE and save (or tick 'Show add more button' on the widget in Manage form display).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article field field_fwam_disable currently shows the field_widget_add_more 'Add another item' button. Turn that button off for this field (leave the field in place) and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default set the field_fwam_disable component's third_party_settings.field_widget_add_more.add_more to FALSE (or unset the field_widget_add_more third-party settings key) and save. The field itself must remain.
